capabilities: play preset soundscapes from the status bar
create custom soundscapes from YouTube links
play local MP3 files with a mini-player and dedicated view
control volume, seek, shuffle, and track switching
auto-play a selected soundscape on launch
extras: The plugin occasionally contacts its GitHub repository to check for a new version. README includes a tip jar link and points users to open GitHub issues for new soundscape requests or bug reports.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to play background music or ambient sounds while working in the vault.

relations.evidence: This plugin makes use of the Youtube IFrame API and includes that script as a result.

summary: Status bar music and ambiance player that plays preset lofi, nature, and relaxation soundscapes, custom YouTube playlists, and a local MP3 library.
